# DotGridChart

## Overview

`DotGridChart` is a top-level compound chart component that composes `ChartHeader`, `ChartLegend`, `DataDisplay`, `DotGridGroup`, and `ChartFooter` into a complete dot-grid visualisation. It follows the **Organised Props Pattern** with two meaningful layers: Parent Props and Child Configs.

Data flows from the chart level down to `DotGridGroup` (dot rendering) and `ChartLegend` (auto-generated legend items). All colours resolve at paint time from `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}` CSS custom properties injected by the DataVis CSS pipeline — no hard-coded values.

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `903:155182`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=903-155182

## Architecture

```
DotGridChart
├── ChartAccessibility (screen reader wrapper)
│   ├── ChartHeader (ChartTitle + ChartSubtitle)
│   ├── ChartLegend (optional, up to 12 ChartKey items — auto-generated)
│   ├── DataDisplay (optional, KPI block)
│   │   ├── mainLabel
│   │   ├── DataHead (DataLead + SupportingData)
│   │   └── Badge + SupportingLabel
│   ├── dotGridGroupWrapper (flex: 1 — fills remaining space)
│   │   └── DotGridGroup
│   │       └── dot[] (coloured div elements from data)
│   └── ChartFooter (source + notes)
```

## Import

```tsx
import { DotGridChart } from '@oneui/datavis';
```

## Data Formats

### Canonical Format (Recommended)

```tsx
import type { ChartDataPoint } from '@oneui/datavis';

const data: ChartDataPoint[] = [
  { id: 'used', category: 'Used', value: 37 },
  { id: 'remaining', category: 'Remaining', value: 63 },
];
```

In `"percentage"` mode (`dotFillType` default), values are proportions (37:63 → 37 % vs 63 %). In `"counted"` mode, values are literal dot counts.

### Legacy Format (Deprecated)

```tsx
import type { LegacyDotGridData } from '@oneui/datavis';

const data: LegacyDotGridData[] = [
  { label: 'Used', value: 37 },
  { label: 'Remaining', value: 63 },
];
```

Both formats are normalised internally. Legacy format logs a deprecation warning in development. Migrate to `ChartDataPoint[]`.

## Props Interface

```tsx
interface DotGridChartProps {
  // Layer 2 — parent props
  data: ChartDataPoint[] | LegacyDotGridData[];
  width?: number | string;           // default: 432
  height?: number | string;
  fullWidth?: boolean;               // default: false
  chartHeader?: boolean;             // default: true
  chartLegend?: boolean;             // default: true
  dataDisplay?: boolean;             // default: false
  chartFooter?: boolean;             // default: true
  animated?: boolean;                // default: false

  // Layer 3 — child configs
  chartHeaderConfig?: ChartHeaderConfig;
  chartLegendConfig?: ChartLegendConfig;
  dataDisplayConfig?: DataDisplayConfig;
  dotGridGroupConfig?: DotGridGroupConfig;
  chartFooterConfig?: ChartFooterConfig;

  // Accessibility
  accessibility?: AccessibilityConfig;
}
```

## Props

| ------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------- |

| `height`      | `number \| string`                        | —       | Total chart height                                  |
| `fullWidth`   | `boolean`                                 | `false` | Stretch to 100% of parent container — ignores width |

| `chartLegend` | `boolean`                                 | `true`  | Show ChartLegend                                    |
| `dataDisplay` | `boolean`                                 | `false` | Show DataDisplay above dot grid                     |
| `chartFooter` | `boolean`                                 | `true`  | Show ChartFooter                                    |
| `animated`    | `boolean`                                 | `false` | Enable entry animation and data transition          |

## Usage Examples

### Basic Chart

```tsx
<DotGridChart
  data={[
    { id: 'used', category: 'Used', value: 37 },
    { id: 'remaining', category: 'Remaining', value: 63 },
  ]}
  height={500}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Resource usage.',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Proportional breakdown.',
  }}
/>
```

### Full Configuration

```tsx
<DotGridChart
  data={data}
  width={432}
  height={600}
  chartHeader
  chartLegend
  dataDisplay
  chartFooter
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Resource allocation.',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Proportional breakdown of resource usage.',
  }}
  chartLegendConfig={{ type: 'circle' }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mainLabelValue: 'Active users.',
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '2,390', dataSupportingValue: '/ 3,000' },
    badgeConfig: { value: '37%' },
  }}
  dotGridGroupConfig={{ dotFillType: 'percentage' }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Jio Analytics.',
    annotationRightValue: 'FY 2025–26.',
  }}
  accessibility={{ enabled: true, dataTable: true }}
/>
```

### Full Width

```tsx
<DotGridChart
  data={data}
  height={500}
  fullWidth
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Fills the container.' }}
/>
```

### Counted Mode

```tsx
<DotGridChart
  data={[
    { id: 'passed', category: 'Passed', value: 18 },
    { id: 'failed', category: 'Failed', value: 4 },
  ]}
  dotGridGroupConfig={{ dotFillType: 'counted' }}
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Test results — literal dot counts.' }}
/>
```

### Custom colors per data item

```tsx
<DotGridChart
  data={[
    { id: 'a', category: 'Segment A', value: 30, color: '#e63946' },
    { id: 'b', category: 'Segment B', value: 70 },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Custom color override.' }}
/>
```

## Design Tokens

All visual values read from the CSS cascade — zero hard-coded values.

| Property        | CSS custom property                        | Layer          |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------ | -------------- |
| Section gap     | `var(--DotGridChart-gap, var(--Spacing-5))` | CSS module     |
| Colour slot 1   | `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)`         | DataVis pipeline |
| Colour slot 2   | `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-2)`         | DataVis pipeline |
| …               | `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n})`       | DataVis pipeline |
| Colour slot 12  | `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-12)`        | DataVis pipeline |

The DataVis pipeline tokens are injected by `generateDataVisCSS` → `useStyleInjection` → `@layer brand`. Colours 1–6 come from the brand palette; 7–12 from `datavis-categorical-extended.css`.

## Legend Auto-Generation

When `chartLegend={true}` and no `chartLegendConfig.items` is provided:

1. Scans `data` for unique categories (canonical `category` or legacy `label`).
2. Assigns `color: var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n})` in slot order (clamped 1–12).
3. Uses `data[n].color` override when present — bypasses token chain.
4. Slices to **12 items maximum**.

## Height Behaviour

`height` controls the **total chart height**. The `DotGridGroup` wrapper uses `flex: 1` to fill the remaining vertical space after header, legend, DataDisplay, and footer.

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  ChartHeader                           │  ← auto height
├────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ChartLegend (optional)                │  ← auto height
├────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  DataDisplay (optional)                │  ← auto height
├────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                        │
│          DotGridGroup                  │  ← flex: 1 (fills remaining)
│                                        │
├────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ChartFooter                           │  ← auto height
└────────────────────────────────────────┘
          Total height: `height` prop
```

## Entry Animation

When `animated={true}`, dots fade in with a diagonal wave from the top-left toward the bottom-right. Each dot's delay is `(row + col) × offsetDelay`. Timing values resolve from motion tokens (`--Motion-Duration-Expressive-*`, `--Motion-Easing-*`) — no hard-coded milliseconds.

### Data Transition

After the entry wave settles (`entrySettled = true`), swapping the `data` prop triggers a simultaneous `background-color` crossfade on all dots. The transition is gated so entry and transition animations never overlap.

## Accessibility

Three-layer ARIA pattern:

1. **`ChartAccessibility` wrapper** — `role="figure"`, auto-generated summary, hidden data table, `aria-live` region.
2. **`useChartAccessibility` hook** — debounces hover/focus data into the live region. Announces: `"{category}, {value}, {percentage}% of total"`.
3. **`useRovingTabIndex` inside `DotGridGroup`** — category-level keyboard navigation. `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` move between categories.

See `ChartAccessibility.md` for full `AccessibilityConfig` options.
